summary: Identify declarations whose names appear free in replacements and occur on paths through those declarations in the expression DAG.

traps.quote: Graph paths and replacement-tree depth may be linear in the node count.
traps.consequence: O(n²) naive algorithms timeout; 250k × path-length iterations exceeds time limits.
traps.guard: Design solution respecting DAG structure; avoid per-node iteration over all paths.

traps.quote: a node may have multiple incoming child references. Its meaning for this task is its complete unfolding into a tree.
traps.consequence: Incorrect capture detection; same var node represents multiple distinct occurrences with different scopes.
traps.guard: Process all paths to each node or conceptually unfold DAG; do not process each node occurrence once.

traps.quote: An original declaration is capturing if there exists at least one replaced occurrence such that: the occurrence's path crosses the scoped edge introducing that declaration, and the declaration's name is free in the replacement.
traps.consequence: Misidentified capturing declarations; only path crossing OR only free-in-replacement is insufficient.
traps.guard: Check both conditions for every replaced occurrence: scoped edge crossed AND name is free in replacement.

traps.quote: A bind, let, or match term type defines distinct scope rules for declarations, body, and auxiliary terms.
traps.consequence: Wrong scope analysis; declarations applied over wrong subterms; incorrect capture detection.
traps.guard: Implement exact per-term-type scope rules; track which subterms fall under which declarations.

traps.quote: Every auxiliary term uses the scope surrounding the whole `match`, not the arm's scope.
traps.consequence: Auxiliary terms incorrectly analyzed as if in arm scope; wrong declarations active.
traps.guard: Evaluate auxiliaries in outer match scope; do not include arm-local declarations in auxiliary scope.

traps.quote: the declaration's name is free in the replacement
traps.consequence: False negatives or false positives; missing capture or over-reporting if free-variable analysis is incomplete.
traps.guard: Traverse entire replacement tree; identify all names bound by replacement's declarations and subtract from all names.

input_shape: List of up to 250k term nodes; two roots; target name; max 500k child references and declaration edges; DAG may have paths of linear depth.
output_shape: Python list of integers (declaration IDs), sorted in increasing order, or empty list.
invariants: Expression root has no incoming reference; every other expression node has exactly one parent within its structure.
Replacement root has no parent; every other replacement node has exactly one parent within its structure.
Expression graph is acyclic; replacement tree is acyclic; both have disjoint reachable node sets.
max_scale: 250,000 total nodes across both structures; 500,000 child references plus declaration edges; linear graph depth.
